candidates.change_summary: Replace 'return true;' with 'return false;' to change the return value on success.
Delete 'return true;' so the function returns the default bool value (false) on success.
Remove the require that checks tos.length == vs.length, allowing transfers with mismatched array sizes.
Change the loop bound from tos.length to vs.length, causing either early termination or out-of-bounds access when array lengths differ.
Remove the require(_s) inside the loop, causing the function to return true even if a transferFrom call fails.
Remove the require that addr != address(this), allowing the contract to call transferFrom on itself.
Replace the selector from transferFrom to transfer, changing the function called on the token contract.
Swap the order of tos[i] and msg.sender in the call arguments, sending tokens from tos[i] to msg.sender instead of the reverse.
